title: Upgrade extension manifest
description: Authoring schema for standalone Upgrade extenders using native host MCP registration. The manifest identifies Upgrade content, skill roots, skill trait gates, and optional one-shot Upgrade hooks. Configure MCP servers in the host plugin or agent configuration.

id.description: Globally unique extension id. Doubles as the Copilot CLI plugin id and as the value scenarios use in `requires-extension`.

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in diagnostic output and (future) marketplace listings.

version.description: SemVer of the extension itself, independent of the orchestrator version.

enabled.description: Enables this extender's Upgrade skills and hooks. Default true. Native host MCP registration and permissions are configured independently.

traits.description: Optional expression gating all skills from this extender. Does not gate MCP registration, tool calls, or fact-collection hooks. Grammar: atom (`X`), OR (`X | Y`), AND (`X & Y` or `X + Y`), NOT (`!X`), parentheses. Case-insensitive. Null / empty = always applies.

skills.description: Optional skill-root path(s) relative to the plugin root. When present, these roots are loaded in addition to the default `skills/` and `upgrade/skills/` directory-convention lookups — all skill layers are merged and skill-id collisions are deduped by the aggregator. Use to ship skills under a non-conventional folder or to expose multiple skill roots (e.g. shared base + scenario-specific). Paths that resolve outside the plugin root are rejected.

upgradeHooks.description: Optional one-shot commands keyed by Upgrade hook name. The collect_facts hook reports repository facts and traits. Each command reads one JSON request from stdin, writes one JSON response to stdout, and exits.

command.description: Executable or interpreter to run. Supports ${pluginRoot}.

workingDirectory.description: Working directory for the hook. Supports ${pluginRoot}. Null uses the orchestrator's working directory.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional time budget for the entire invocation. Cannot extend the orchestrator's own deadline.
